entities.summary: Pauline of the Agonizing Heart of Jesus, C.I.I.C., was a Catholic immigrant from Austria-Hungary to Brazil who became the foundress of the Congregation of the Little Sisters of the Immaculate Conception, religious sisters who serve the poor.
